newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Dec 13.

text.p: Advisory panel to the Finance Minister filed a report calling for reduction in the fiscal budget deficit at central and local governments to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) by 2005.
Hitachi Ltd, Toshiba Corp and NEC Corp freezing plans to build new semiconductor plants in Japan and overseas due to weakness in chip prices.
